title: feat(plugin-auth): the platform OP emits the standard locale claim at userinfo
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XFnVxNqd2vYJpRNfm3Fxkww)_

Fixes #25529

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

The OIDC provider plugin-auth composes (`oauthProvider({...})` in `auth-manager-plugin-list.ts`, where the composition now lives after the `auth-manager.ts` split) gains `customUserInfoClaims`. It returns `{ locale }` only when the access token's scopes include `profile` and the user's `sys_user.locale`, read through the data engine in system context, is a tag the platform's one column reader accepts (`normalizeRecipientLocale`: non-empty, BCP-47-shaped, never the stringified-nothing literals). Otherwise it returns nothing. The rule lives in the new `oidc-userinfo-locale-claim.ts`.

- No new host configuration key, no new column, no better-auth `additionalField`: every ObjectStack OP emits the claim.
- Userinfo only. The ID token is untouched (the provider keeps profile claims out of it); the first test asserts the ID token carries no `locale`.
- A failed locale read never fails userinfo: the claim is omitted and the host logger gets one `warn` naming the user (functional degradation, AGENTS.md degradation log levels).

## Measured premises (tree `05f7758f05`)

- better-auth and `@better-auth/oauth-provider` are both `1.7.12` on `main`. `customUserInfoClaims(info: { user, scopes, jwt, requestedClaims })` exists there (`oauth-DXiqbRzK.d.mts:1761`), is called only when scopes are non-empty, and its result is merged after the provider's own claims with `sub` re-pinned (`introspect-DeWu79D4.mjs` userinfo).
- The OP composition named in the card moved: `auth-manager.ts:4252` on the filing tree is now `auth-manager-plugin-list.ts:500`. Still plugin-auth, inside the claimed file surface.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oidc-userinfo-locale-claim.test.ts` drives a REAL `AuthManager` with its OIDC provider on, over the shared in-memory engine, through its HTTP surface (sign-up, create-client, authorize with PKCE, consent, token, userinfo):

- zh-CN user under `profile`: userinfo `locale: "zh-CN"`, ID token without `locale`;
- no stored locale: no `locale` key;
- stored `"undefined"` literal: no `locale` key;
- `profile` not granted: no `locale`, and the column is never read;
- the locale read throws: userinfo still 200 with `sub`/`name`, no `locale`, exactly one `warn` carrying the user id;
- **one round trip end to end**: a second `AuthManager` as the platform RP (`genericOAuth`, provider `objectstack-cloud`, configured by OIDC discovery) signs in through this OP over a `fetch` routed to the OP's handler (the discovery document through `oauthProviderOpenIdConfigMetadata`, as `registerOidcDiscoveryRoutes` mounts it). The RP's JIT path (`idp-locale-claim.ts`) stores `zh-CN` on the RP's own `sys_user`.

Red first, on `main` plus the test only (`b6c90526`): 3 failed / 13 passed — the zh-CN leg (`expected undefined to be 'zh-CN'`), the read-failure leg (`warn` called 0 times) and the round trip (RP user's locale `undefined`). The other three legs assert absence and are green on `main` by construction.

Green with the fix (`630e39c2`): 16/16 in the file (the count includes the imported shared engine module's own cases).

Ablation (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `customUserInfoClaims: ({ user, scopes }) =>` renamed so the provider never reads it; the test imports `./auth-manager` from source, no `dist` in the path): anchor 1 → 0, blob `dade996dd516` → `2de5c1541934`; the same 3 legs red (3 failed / 13 passed); restored to the HEAD blob `dade996dd516`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: exit 0 (incl. `check:test-typecheck`: no new test-layer errors).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run`: 196 files / 3737 passed / 10 skipped, exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/plugins/plugin-auth`: exit 0.

## Gates (head `630e39c2`)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this diff: 68 commands, every exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: 68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, exit 0. Three first runs exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, nothing measured) and were re-run green after the prerequisite: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (shallow clone, positive-control commit fetched), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs a full build; `turbo run build` 120/120), `check:type-check-debt` (lock budget spent behind that build). Every CI family is read off this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

## Acceptance notes

- Discovery `claims_supported` does not list `locale`. The provider computes that list itself from its standard-claim table and overwrites any `claims` option; only `advertisedMetadata.claims_supported` would replace it wholesale. OIDC Discovery makes the list RECOMMENDED and non-exhaustive, the platform RP never reads it, and a `claims.userinfo` request naming `locale` is filtered by it, so a client asking for `locale` individually without `profile` gets nothing, which matches the ruled scope rule. Noted, not filed.
- A second read site of `sys_user.locale` exists beside `storedRecipientLocale` (email/SMS). It shares the column constant and the normalizer; it does not reuse that function because that function swallows a read failure silently by contract, and this order asks the failure to be logged.
